name: somi
description: A small kernel for coding agents: bare-first by default, one reviewer only when the real diff calls for it, state written by tools, and the OS sandbox as the security boundary.

commands.name: task
commands.description: Do one piece of work bare-first; review only if the real diff calls for it.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Opt-in: feature-sized milestones, each with a test or command that proves it.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review a diff once, on request.

commands.name: ship
commands.description: Run the full suite, then prepare the pull request text.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show work, findings and decisions from the journal.
